effects: Runs in the signer's Safe via delegatecall and overwrites the Safe's implementation (storage slot 0) with the fixed SAFE_SINGLETON 0xFf51A5898e281Db6DfC7855790607438dF2ca44b (Safe v1.5.0). From then on all of the account's logic runs from that code.
No tokens or native value move. The function is not payable.
formats.shown: "Migrate Safe" and the migration contract's address. It does not say which version or implementation the Safe moves to.

findings.title: migrateSingleton intent "Migrate Safe" does not name the target version or implementation the account switches to.
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol migrateSingleton(): `singleton = SAFE_SINGLETON;` with SAFE_SINGLETON immutable = 0xFf51A5898e281Db6DfC7855790607438dF2ca44b (meta.json constructorArguments). descriptor.json: "intent": "Migrate Safe", and the only field is `@.to` 'Migration contract'.
findings.fix: The target is a constant of this deployment, so put it in the intent text, e.g. "Upgrade Safe to v1.5.0". Optionally rename the field to say it is the v1.5.0 migration contract.

findings.title: migrateSingleton: the new singleton address is an immutable, not calldata, so no field can display it.
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol: `address public immutable SAFE_SINGLETON;` set in the constructor. migrateSingleton() takes no parameters.
findings.fix: Name the version in the intent. The address itself can only come from the wallet's knowledge of this deployment.

effects: Runs in the signer's Safe via delegatecall and overwrites the Safe's implementation (slot 0) with SAFE_SINGLETON 0xFf51A5898e281Db6DfC7855790607438dF2ca44b (Safe v1.5.0). Emits ChangedMasterCopy.

Then calls setFallbackHandler(SAFE_FALLBACK_HANDLER = 0x3EfCBb83A4A7AfcB4F68D501E2c2203a38be77f4) on the Safe itself. This replaces the account's current fallback handler, which answers unknown calls and EIP-1271 signature checks.
No tokens or native value move. The function is not payable.
formats.shown: "Migrate Safe" and the migration contract's address. The screen is identical to migrateSingleton, so nothing says the fallback handler is replaced.

findings.title: migrateWithFallbackHandler replaces the Safe's fallback handler, but the screen never mentions it.
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol migrateWithFallbackHandler(): `migrateSingleton(); ISafe(payable(address(this))).setFallbackHandler(SAFE_FALLBACK_HANDLER);`. descriptor.json gives "intent": "Migrate Safe", the same as migrateSingleton(), and its only field is `@.to`. The account's existing fallback handler (which may be a custom one, such as a 4337 module) is overwritten, and no text distinguishes this call from the singleton-only migration.
findings.fix: Use an intent like "Upgrade Safe to v1.5.0 and set fallback handler", and state the handler (CompatibilityFallbackHandler v1.5.0) in the intent or a label.

findings.title: migrateWithFallbackHandler intent does not name the target Safe version.

findings.fix: Describe them in the intent text.
